name: Oral Comprehension
desc: The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

name: Written Comprehension
desc: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

name: Oral Expression
desc: The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.

name: Written Expression
desc: The ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand.

name: Fluency of Ideas
desc: The ability to come up with a number of ideas about a topic (the number of ideas is important, not their quality, correctness, or creativity).

name: Originality
desc: The ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem.

name: Problem Sensitivity
desc: The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem.

name: Deductive Reasoning
desc: The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.

name: Inductive Reasoning
desc: The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events).

name: Information Ordering
desc: The ability to arrange things or actions in a certain order or pattern according to a specific rule or set of rules (e.g., patterns of numbers, letters, words, pictures, mathematical operations).

name: Category Flexibility
desc: The ability to generate or use different sets of rules for combining or grouping things in different ways.

name: Mathematical Reasoning
desc: The ability to choose the right mathematical methods or formulas to solve a problem.

name: Number Facility
desc: The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly and correctly.

name: Memorization
desc: The ability to remember information such as words, numbers, pictures, and procedures.

name: Speed of Closure
desc: The ability to quickly make sense of, combine, and organize information into meaningful patterns.

name: Flexibility of Closure
desc: The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material.

name: Perceptual Speed
desc: The ability to quickly and accurately compare similarities and differences among sets of letters, numbers, objects, pictures, or patterns. The things to be compared may be presented at the same time or one after the other. This ability also includes comparing

name: Spatial Orientation
desc: The ability to know your location in relation to the environment or to know where other objects are in relation to you.

name: Visualization
desc: The ability to imagine how something will look after it is moved around or when its parts are moved or rearranged.

name: Selective Attention
desc: The ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time without being distracted.

name: Time Sharing
desc: The ability to shift back and forth between two or more activities or sources of information (such as speech, sounds, touch, or other sources).

name: Arm-Hand Steadiness
desc: The ability to keep your hand and arm steady while moving your arm or while holding your arm and hand in one position.

name: Manual Dexterity
desc: The ability to quickly move your hand, your hand together with your arm, or your two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.

name: Finger Dexterity
desc: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.

name: Control Precision
desc: The ability to quickly and repeatedly adjust the controls of a machine or a vehicle to exact positions.

name: Multilimb Coordination
desc: The ability to coordinate two or more limbs (for example, two arms, two legs, or one leg and one arm) while sitting, standing, or lying down. It does not involve performing the activities while the whole body is in motion.

name: Response Orientation
desc: The ability to choose quickly between two or more movements in response to two or more different signals (lights, sounds, pictures). It includes the speed with which the correct response is started with the hand, foot, or other body part.

name: Rate Control
desc: The ability to time your movements or the movement of a piece of equipment in anticipation of changes in the speed and/or direction of a moving object or scene.

name: Reaction Time
desc: The ability to quickly respond (with the hand, finger, or foot) to a signal (sound, light, picture) when it appears.

name: Wrist-Finger Speed
desc: The ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

name: Speed of Limb Movement
desc: The ability to quickly move the arms and legs.

name: Static Strength
desc: The ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull, or carry objects.

name: Explosive Strength
desc: The ability to use short bursts of muscle force to propel oneself (as in jumping or sprinting), or to throw an object.

name: Dynamic Strength
desc: The ability to exert muscle force repeatedly or continuously over time. This involves muscular endurance and resistance to muscle fatigue.

name: Trunk Strength
desc: The ability to use your abdominal and lower back muscles to support part of the body repeatedly or continuously over time without "giving out" or fatiguing.

name: Stamina
desc: The ability to exert yourself physically over long periods of time without getting winded or out of breath.

name: Extent Flexibility
desc: The ability to bend, stretch, twist, or reach with your body, arms, and/or legs.

name: Dynamic Flexibility
desc: The ability to quickly and repeatedly bend, stretch, twist, or reach out with your body, arms, and/or legs.

name: Gross Body Coordination
desc: The ability to coordinate the movement of your arms, legs, and torso together when the whole body is in motion.

name: Gross Body Equilibrium
desc: The ability to keep or regain your body balance or stay upright when in an unstable position.

name: Near Vision
desc: The ability to see details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).

name: Far Vision
desc: The ability to see details at a distance.

name: Visual Color Discrimination
desc: The ability to match or detect differences between colors, including shades of color and brightness.

name: Night Vision
desc: The ability to see under low-light conditions.

name: Peripheral Vision
desc: The ability to see objects or movement of objects to one's side when the eyes are looking ahead.

name: Depth Perception
desc: The ability to judge which of several objects is closer or farther away from you, or to judge the distance between you and an object.

name: Glare Sensitivity
desc: The ability to see objects in the presence of a glare or bright lighting.

name: Hearing Sensitivity
desc: The ability to detect or tell the differences between sounds that vary in pitch and loudness.

name: Auditory Attention
desc: The ability to focus on a single source of sound in the presence of other distracting sounds.

name: Sound Localization
desc: The ability to tell the direction from which a sound originated.

name: Speech Recognition
desc: The ability to identify and understand the speech of another person.

name: Speech Clarity
desc: The ability to speak clearly so others can understand you.

name: Realistic

name: Investigative
desc: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, living organisms, disease or other forms of impairment, or human behavior. Investigative occupations are often associated with physical, life, medical, or social sciences, and can be found in the field

name: Artistic
desc: Work involves creating original visual artwork, performances, written works, food, or music for a variety of media, or applying artistic principles to the design of various objects and materials. Artistic occupations are often associated with visual arts, appl

name: Social
desc: Work involves helping, teaching, advising, assisting, or providing service to others. Social occupations are often associated with social, health care, personal service, teaching/education, or religious activities.

name: Enterprising
desc: Work involves managing, negotiating, marketing, or selling, typically in a business setting, or leading or advising people in political and legal situations. Enterprising occupations are often associated with business initiatives, sales, marketing/advertising,

name: Conventional
desc: Work involves following procedures and regulations to organize information or data, typically in a business setting. Conventional occupations are often associated with office work, accounting, mathematics/statistics, information technology, finance, or human r

name: First Interest High-Point
desc: Primary-Rank Descriptiveness

name: Second Interest High-Point
desc: Secondary-Cutoff/Rank Descriptiveness

name: Third Interest High-Point
desc: Tertiary-Cutoff/Rank Descriptiveness

name: Required Level of Education
desc: The level of education required to perform a job.

name: Job-Related Professional Certification
desc: Possession of an occupational or industry certification to perform the job.

name: Reading Comprehension
desc: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

name: Active Listening
desc: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

name: Writing
desc: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

name: Speaking
desc: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

name: Mathematics
desc: Using mathematics to solve problems.

name: Science
desc: Using scientific rules and methods to solve problems.

name: Critical Thinking
desc: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

name: Active Learning
desc: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

name: Learning Strategies
desc: Selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.

name: Monitoring
desc: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

name: Administration and Management
desc: Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

name: Administrative
desc: Knowledge of administrative and office procedures and systems such as word processing, managing files and records, stenography and transcription, designing forms, and workplace terminology.

name: Economics and Accounting
desc: Knowledge of economic and accounting principles and practices, the financial markets, banking, and the analysis and reporting of financial data.

name: Sales and Marketing
desc: Knowledge of principles and methods for showing, promoting, and selling products or services. This includes marketing strategy and tactics, product demonstration, sales techniques, and sales control systems.

name: Customer and Personal Service
desc: Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.

name: Personnel and Human Resources
desc: Knowledge of principles and procedures for personnel recruitment, selection, training, compensation and benefits, labor relations and negotiation, and personnel information systems.

name: Transportation
desc: Knowledge of principles and methods for moving people or goods by air, rail, sea, or road, including the relative costs and benefits.

name: Production and Processing
desc: Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.

name: Food Production
desc: Knowledge of techniques and equipment for planting, growing, and harvesting food products (both plant and animal) for consumption, including storage/handling techniques.

name: Computers and Electronics
desc: Knowledge of circuit boards, processors, chips, electronic equipment, and computer hardware and software, including applications and programming.

name: Engineering and Technology
desc: Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology. This includes applying principles, techniques, procedures, and equipment to the design and production of various goods and services.

name: Design
desc: Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.

name: Building and Construction
desc: Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction or repair of houses, buildings, or other structures such as highways and roads.

name: Mechanical
desc: Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.

name: Mathematics
desc: Knowledge of arithmetic, algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics, and their applications.

name: Physics
desc: Knowledge and prediction of physical principles, laws, their interrelationships, and applications to understanding fluid, material, and atmospheric dynamics, and mechanical, electrical, atomic and sub-atomic structures and processes.

name: Chemistry
desc: Knowledge of the chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo. This includes uses of chemicals and their interactions, danger signs, production techniques, and disposal method

name: Biology
desc: Knowledge of plant and animal organisms, their tissues, cells, functions, interdependencies, and interactions with each other and the environment.

name: Psychology
desc: Knowledge of human behavior and performance; individual differences in ability, personality, and interests; learning and motivation; psychological research methods; and the assessment and treatment of behavioral and affective disorders.

name: Sociology and Anthropology
desc: Knowledge of group behavior and dynamics, societal trends and influences, human migrations, ethnicity, cultures, and their history and origins.

name: Geography
desc: Knowledge of principles and methods for describing the features of land, sea, and air masses, including their physical characteristics, locations, interrelationships, and distribution of plant, animal, and human life.

name: Medicine and Dentistry
desc: Knowledge of the information and techniques needed to diagnose and treat human injuries, diseases, and deformities. This includes symptoms, treatment alternatives, drug properties and interactions, and preventive health-care measures.

name: Therapy and Counseling
desc: Knowledge of principles, methods, and procedures for diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation of physical and mental dysfunctions, and for career counseling and guidance.

name: Education and Training
desc: Knowledge of principles and methods for curriculum and training design, teaching and instruction for individuals and groups, and the measurement of training effects.

name: English Language
desc: Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, and rules of composition and grammar.

name: Foreign Language
desc: Knowledge of the structure and content of a foreign (non-English) language including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition and grammar, and pronunciation.

name: Fine Arts
desc: Knowledge of the theory and techniques required to compose, produce, and perform works of music, dance, visual arts, drama, and sculpture.

name: History and Archeology
desc: Knowledge of historical events and their causes, indicators, and effects on civilizations and cultures.

name: Philosophy and Theology
desc: Knowledge of different philosophical systems and religions. This includes their basic principles, values, ethics, ways of thinking, customs, practices, and their impact on human culture.

name: Public Safety and Security
desc: Knowledge of relevant equipment, policies, procedures, and strategies to promote effective local, state, or national security operations for the protection of people, data, property, and institutions.

name: Law and Government
desc: Knowledge of laws, legal codes, court procedures, precedents, government regulations, executive orders, agency rules, and the democratic political process.

name: Telecommunications
desc: Knowledge of transmission, broadcasting, switching, control, and operation of telecommunications systems.

name: Communications and Media
desc: Knowledge of media production, communication, and dissemination techniques and methods. This includes alternative ways to inform and entertain via written, oral, and visual media.

name: Mechanics/Electronics
desc: Work involves maintaining and repairing of machinery, such as automotive engines, electronic equipment, computers, and communication systems.

name: Health Care Service
desc: Work involves providing health care services to individuals to include the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases and other forms of illness or impairment.

name: Religious Activities
desc: Work involves conducting religious worship, leading a church or other religious group, and offering moral guidance associated with beliefs and practices of a religious faith.

name: Personal Service
desc: Work involves providing personal services to individuals in need of non-medical assistance such as helping arrange or plan for travel, meals, or events.

name: Professional Advising
desc: Work involves providing expert advice, coaching, and counseling on topics such as careers, educational opportunities, and educational and professional development.

name: Business Initiatives
desc: Work involves creating strategic plans or taking actions to expand an organization's business or market share.

name: Sales
desc: Work involves selling goods or services.

name: Marketing/Advertising
desc: Work involves promoting or creating a public image for products, services, or organizations to attract interest, engagement, or sales.

name: Finance
desc: Work involves directing and managing financial activities, such as planning and investments for an individual or organization to generate income.

name: Accounting
desc: Work involves examining, analyzing, and interpreting accounting records for financial statements, or maintaining, auditing, or evaluating records and accounts.

name: Human Resources
desc: Work involves recruiting, selecting, and training job applicants, maintaining employee personnel records, administering compensation and employee-benefit programs, and conducting employee performance reviews.

name: Office Work
desc: Work involves clerical and administrative tasks for an organization such as answering phones, bookkeeping, updating records, scheduling appointments or meetings, and editing of documents and files.

name: Management/Administration
desc: Work involves planning, directing, or coordinating the daily operations of an organization, and overseeing personnel, business, or administrative services.

name: Public Speaking
desc: Work involves speaking before an audience to educate, entertain, or influence the listeners.

name: Politics
desc: Work involves engaging in political activities to influence government policy.

name: Law
desc: Work involves studying and applying legal knowledge.

name: Construction/Woodwork
desc: Work involves constructing, installing, or repairing structures and fixtures made of wood.

name: Transportation/Machine Operation
desc: Work involves driving vehicles, such as vans, trucks, trains, and buses to transport people or materials. Work can also involve operating heavy equipment, such as cranes, forklifts, bulldozers, and backhoes to move materials or earth.

name: Physical/Manual Labor
desc: Work involves manually unloading and moving freight, stock, luggage, or other materials, or performing other physical labor.

name: Protective Service
desc: Work involves maintaining order and protecting life and property by conducting investigations and enforcing laws and regulations to prevent or solve crimes.

name: Agriculture
desc: Work involves planting, cultivating, and harvesting crops, plants, or trees, or raising farm animals. Work can also involve preparing plant and animal products for distribution to consumers, or protecting natural resources to maximize their use in farming.

name: Nature/Outdoors
desc: Work involves planning, restoring, and conserving natural areas and wildlife habitats.

name: Animal Service
desc: Work involves feeding, grooming, exercising, or otherwise providing care to promote and maintain the well-being of pets and other animals in settings such as kennels, animal shelters, and zoos.

name: Athletics
desc: Work involves training, practicing, or competing in athletic events, or supporting those participating in athletics through coaching, training, or officiating.

name: Engineering
desc: Work involves applying science and technology to the design, building, testing, and use of electrical and electronic components, mechanical devices and machines, automotive, marine, and aerospace equipment and vehicles, materials, or structures.

name: Physical Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, materials, and phenomena through scientific disciplines such as physics, chemistry, astronomy, meteorology, or geology.

name: Life Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching living organisms through scientific disciplines such as biology, botany, zoology, microbiology, physiology, biochemistry, or zoology.

name: Medical Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching the causes, nature, effects, and treatments of disease or other forms of impairment or illness.

name: Social Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching human behavior, society, politics, and social relationships through scientific disciplines such as psychology, sociology, economics, or political science.

name: Humanities
desc: Work involves studying and researching aspects of human history, culture, and language through disciplines such as history, philosophy, the language arts, or area/ethnic studies.

name: Mathematics/Statistics
desc: Work involves developing and applying mathematics and statistical theory and methods.

name: Information Technology
desc: Work involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining computer software, hardware, networks, and systems.

name: Visual Arts
desc: Work involves creating original visual artwork for a variety of media and purposes using various techniques and software.

name: Applied Arts and Design
desc: Work involves applying artistic principles to the design and creation of various objects and materials.

name: Performing Arts
desc: Work involves acting as a performer in dance, comedy, or dramatic productions, choreographing of dance performances, or producing of live or recorded entertainment.

name: Music
desc: Work involves conducting, composing, or playing music or singing.

name: Creative Writing
desc: Work involves developing creative written works, such as novels, scripts, song lyrics, poetry, stories, or advertisements.

name: Media
desc: Work involves producing, developing, writing, directing, or presenting information through print, radio, television, or digital media.

name: Culinary Art
desc: Work involves preparing, cooking, and presenting food in a distinctive style usually associated with a specific culture or region.

name: Teaching/Education
desc: Work involves teaching through lectures, discussions, and demonstrations in one or more subjects.

name: Social Service
desc: Work involves providing social services and assistance to improve the well-being and social and psychological functioning of children and adults.

name: Related Work Experience
desc: Amount of related work experience required to get hired for the job?

name: On-Site or In-Plant Training
desc: Amount of on-site or in-plant training (e.g., organized class room instruction) required to perform the job?

name: On-the-Job Training
desc: Amount of on the job training required to perform the job?

name: Job-related Apprenticeship
desc: Completion of a job-related apprenticeship to perform the job.

name: Social Perceptiveness
desc: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

name: Coordination
desc: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

name: Persuasion
desc: Persuading others to change their minds or behavior.

name: Negotiation
desc: Bringing others together and trying to reconcile differences.

name: Instructing
desc: Teaching others how to do something.

name: Service Orientation
desc: Actively looking for ways to help people.

name: Complex Problem Solving
desc: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

name: Operations Analysis
desc: Analyzing needs and product requirements to create a design.

name: Technology Design
desc: Generating or adapting equipment and technology to serve user needs.

name: Equipment Selection
desc: Determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.

name: Installation
desc: Installing equipment, machines, wiring, or programs to meet specifications.

name: Programming
desc: Writing computer programs for various purposes.

name: Operations Monitoring
desc: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

name: Operation and Control
desc: Controlling operations of equipment or systems.

name: Equipment Maintenance
desc: Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.

name: Troubleshooting
desc: Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

name: Repairing
desc: Repairing machines or systems using the needed tools.

name: Quality Control Analysis
desc: Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.

name: Judgment and Decision Making
desc: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

name: Systems Analysis
desc: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.

name: Systems Evaluation
desc: Identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system.

name: Time Management
desc: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

name: Management of Financial Resources
desc: Determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures.

name: Management of Material Resources
desc: Obtaining and seeing to the appropriate use of equipment, facilities, and materials needed to do certain work.

name: Management of Personnel Resources
desc: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

name: Getting Information
desc: Observing, receiving, and otherwise obtaining information from all relevant sources.

name: Monitoring Processes, Materials, or Surroundings
desc: Monitoring and reviewing information from materials, events, or the environment, to detect or assess problems.

name: Identifying Objects, Actions, and Events
desc: Identifying information by categorizing, estimating, recognizing differences or similarities, and detecting changes in circumstances or events.

name: Inspecting Equipment, Structures, or Materials
desc: Inspecting equipment, structures, or materials to identify the cause of errors or other problems or defects.

name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information
desc: Estimating sizes, distances, and quantities; or determining time, costs, resources, or materials needed to perform a work activity.

name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People
desc: Assessing the value, importance, or quality of things or people.

name: Processing Information
desc: Compiling, coding, categorizing, calculating, tabulating, auditing, or verifying information or data.

name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards
desc: Using relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations, or standards.

name: Analyzing Data or Information
desc: Identifying the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.

name: Making Decisions and Solving Problems
desc: Analyzing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

name: Thinking Creatively
desc: Developing, designing, or creating new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.

name: Updating and Using Relevant Knowledge
desc: Keeping up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.

name: Developing Objectives and Strategies
desc: Establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.

name: Scheduling Work and Activities
desc: Scheduling events, programs, and activities, as well as the work of others.

name: Organizing, Planning, and Prioritizing Work
desc: Developing specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

name: Performing General Physical Activities
desc: Performing general physical activities includes doing activities that require considerable use of your arms and legs and moving your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping, and handling materials.

name: Handling and Moving Objects
desc: Using hands and arms in handling, installing, positioning, and moving materials, and manipulating things.

name: Controlling Machines and Processes
desc: Using either control mechanisms or direct physical activity to operate machines or processes (not including computers or vehicles).

name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment
desc: Running, maneuvering, navigating, or driving vehicles or mechanized equipment, such as forklifts, passenger vehicles, aircraft, or watercraft.

name: Working with Computers
desc: Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.

name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment
desc: Providing documentation, detailed instructions, drawings, or specifications to tell others about how devices, parts, equipment, or structures are to be fabricated, constructed, assembled, modified, maintained, or used.

name: Repairing and Maintaining Mechanical Equipment
desc: Servicing, repairing, adjusting, and testing machines, devices, moving parts, and equipment that operate primarily on the basis of mechanical (not electronic) principles.

name: Repairing and Maintaining Electronic Equipment
desc: Servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine-tuning, or testing machines, devices, and equipment that operate primarily on the basis of electrical or electronic (not mechanical) principles.

name: Documenting/Recording Information
desc: Entering, transcribing, recording, storing, or maintaining information in written or electronic/magnetic form.

name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others
desc: Translating or explaining what information means and how it can be used.

name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates
desc: Providing information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization
desc: Communicating with people outside the organization, representing the organization to customers, the public, government, and other external sources. This information can be exchanged in person, in writing, or by telephone or e-mail.

name: Establishing and Maintaining Interpersonal Relationships
desc: Developing constructive and cooperative working relationships with others, and maintaining them over time.

name: Assisting and Caring for Others
desc: Providing personal assistance, medical attention, emotional support, or other personal care to others such as coworkers, customers, or patients.

name: Selling or Influencing Others
desc: Convincing others to buy merchandise/goods or to otherwise change their minds or actions.

name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others
desc: Handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public
desc: Performing for people or dealing directly with the public. This includes serving customers in restaurants and stores, and receiving clients or guests.

name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others
desc: Getting members of a group to work together to accomplish tasks.

name: Developing and Building Teams
desc: Encouraging and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

name: Training and Teaching Others
desc: Identifying the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.

name: Guiding, Directing, and Motivating Subordinates
desc: Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

name: Coaching and Developing Others
desc: Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others
desc: Providing guidance and expert advice to management or other groups on technical, systems-, or process-related topics.

name: Performing Administrative Activities
desc: Performing day-to-day administrative tasks such as maintaining information files and processing paperwork.

name: Staffing Organizational Units
desc: Recruiting, interviewing, selecting, hiring, and promoting employees in an organization.

name: Monitoring and Controlling Resources
desc: Monitoring and controlling resources and overseeing the spending of money.

name: Public Speaking
desc: How frequently does your job require public speaking (one speaker with an audience)?

name: Telephone Conversations
desc: How often do you have telephone conversations in this job?

name: E-Mail
desc: How frequently does your job require you to use E-mail?

name: Written Letters and Memos
desc: How frequently does your job require written letters and memos?

name: Face-to-Face Discussions with Individuals and Within Teams
desc: How frequently does your job require face-to-face discussions with individuals and within teams?

name: Contact With Others
desc: How much does this job require the worker to be in contact with others (face-to-face, by telephone, or otherwise) in order to perform it?

name: Work With or Contribute to a Work Group or Team
desc: How important is it to work with or contribute to a work group or team in this job?

name: Deal With External Customers or the Public in General
desc: How important is it to deal with external customers (as in retail sales) or the public in general (as in police work) in this job?

name: Coordinate or Lead Others in Accomplishing Work Activities
desc: How important is it to coordinate or lead others (not as a supervisor or team leader) in accomplishing work activities in this job?

name: Health and Safety of Other Workers
desc: How much responsibility is there for the health and safety of others in this job?

name: Work Outcomes and Results of Other Workers
desc: How responsible is the worker for work outcomes and results of other workers?

name: Conflict Situations
desc: How frequently are there conflict situations the employee has to face in this job?

name: Dealing With Unpleasant, Angry, or Discourteous People
desc: How frequently does the worker have to deal with unpleasant, angry, or discourteous individuals as part of the job requirements?

name: Dealing with Violent or Physically Aggressive People
desc: How frequently does this job require the worker to deal with physical aggression of violent individuals?

name: Indoors, Environmentally Controlled
desc: How often does this job require working indoors in an environmentally controlled environment (like a warehouse with air conditioning)?

name: Indoors, Not Environmentally Controlled
desc: How often does this job require working in an environment that is not environmentally controlled (like a warehouse without air conditioning)?

name: Outdoors, Exposed to All Weather Conditions
desc: How often does this job require working outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions?

name: Outdoors, Under Cover
desc: How often does this job require working outdoors, under cover (like in an open shed)?

name: In an Open Vehicle or Operating Equipment
desc: How often does this job require working in an open vehicle or operating equipment (like a tractor)?

name: In an Enclosed Vehicle or Operate Enclosed Equipment
desc: How often does this job require working in a closed vehicle or operate enclosed equipment (like a car)?

name: Physical Proximity
desc: To what extent does this job require the worker to perform job tasks physically close to other people?

name: Exposed to Sounds, Noise Levels that are Distracting or Uncomfortable
desc: How often does this job require working exposed to sounds and noise levels that are distracting or uncomfortable?

name: Exposed to Very Hot or Cold Temperatures
desc: How often does this job require working in very hot (above 90 F degrees) or very cold (below 32 F degrees) temperatures?

name: Exposed to Extremely Bright or Inadequate Lighting Conditions
desc: How often does this job require working in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions?

name: Exposed to Contaminants
desc: How often does this job require working exposed to contaminants (such as pollutants, gases, dust or odors)?

name: Exposed to Cramped Work Space, Awkward Positions
desc: How often does this job require working in cramped work spaces that requires getting into awkward positions?

name: Exposed to Whole Body Vibration
desc: How often does this job require exposure to whole body vibration (like operating a jackhammer or earth moving equipment)?

name: Exposed to Radiation
desc: How often does this job require exposure to radiation?

name: Exposed to Disease or Infections
desc: How often does this job require exposure to disease/infections?

name: Exposed to High Places
desc: How often does this job require exposure to high places?

name: Exposed to Hazardous Conditions
desc: How often does this job require exposure to hazardous conditions?

name: Exposed to Hazardous Equipment
desc: How often does this job require exposure to hazardous equipment?

name: Exposed to Minor Burns, Cuts, Bites, or Stings
desc: How often does this job require exposure to minor burns, cuts, bites, or stings?

name: Spend Time Sitting
desc: How much does this job require sitting?

name: Spend Time Standing
desc: How much does this job require standing?

name: Spend Time Climbing Ladders, Scaffolds, or Poles
desc: How much does this job require climbing ladders, scaffolds, poles, etc.?

name: Spend Time Walking or Running
desc: How much does this job require walking or running?

name: Spend Time Kneeling, Crouching, Stooping, or Crawling
desc: How much does this job require kneeling, crouching, stooping or crawling?

name: Spend Time Keeping or Regaining Balance
desc: How much does this job require keeping or regaining your balance?

name: Spend Time Using Your Hands to Handle, Control, or Feel Objects, Tools, or Controls
desc: How much does this job require using your hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools or controls?

name: Spend Time Bending or Twisting Your Body
desc: How much does this job require bending or twisting your body?

name: Spend Time Making Repetitive Motions
desc: How much does this job require making repetitive motions?

name: Wear Common Protective or Safety Equipment such as Safety Shoes, Glasses, Gloves, Hearing Protection, Hard Hats, or Life Jackets
desc: How often does this job require wearing common protective or safety equipment such as safety shoes, glasses, gloves, hearing protection, hard hats or life-jackets?

name: Wear Specialized Protective or Safety Equipment such as Breathing Apparatus, Safety Harness, Full Protection Suits, or Radiation Protection
desc: How often does this job require wearing specialized protective or safety equipment such as breathing apparatus, safety harness, full protection suits, or radiation protection?

name: Consequence of Error
desc: How serious would the result usually be if the worker made a mistake that was not easily correctable?

name: Impact of Decisions on Co-workers or Company Results
desc: What results do your decisions usually have on other people or the image or reputation or financial resources of your employer?

name: Frequency of Decision Making
desc: How often is the worker required to make decisions that affect other people, the financial resources, and/or the image and reputation of the organization?

name: Freedom to Make Decisions
desc: How much decision making freedom, without supervision, does the job offer?

name: Degree of Automation
desc: How automated is the job?

name: Importance of Being Exact or Accurate
desc: How important is being very exact or highly accurate in performing this job?

name: Importance of Repeating Same Tasks
desc: How important are continuous, repetitive, physical activities (like key entry) or mental activities (like checking entries in a ledger) to performing this job?

name: Determine Tasks, Priorities and Goals
desc: How much freedom does the worker have in determining the tasks, priorities, or goals of the job?

name: Level of Competition
desc: To what extent does this job require the worker to compete or to be aware of competitive pressures?

name: Time Pressure
desc: How often does this job require the worker to meet strict deadlines?

name: Pace Determined by Speed of Equipment
desc: How important is it to this job that the pace is determined by the speed of equipment or machinery? (This does not refer to keeping busy at all times on this job.)

name: Work Schedules
desc: How regular are the work schedules for this job?

name: Duration of Typical Work Week
desc: Number of hours typically worked in one week.

name: Innovation
desc: A tendency to be inventive, to be imaginative, and to adopt new perspectives on ways to accomplish work.

name: Achievement Orientation
desc: A tendency to establish and maintain personally challenging work-related goals, set high work-related standards, and exert high effort toward meeting those goals and standards.

name: Intellectual Curiosity
desc: A tendency to seek out and acquire new work-related knowledge and obtain a deep understanding of work-related subjects.

name: Tolerance for Ambiguity
desc: A tendency to be comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty at work.

name: Initiative
desc: A tendency to be proactive and take on extra responsibilities and tasks that may fall outside of one's required work role.

name: Adaptability
desc: A tendency to be open to and comfortable with change, new experiences, or ideas at work.

name: Self-Confidence
desc: A tendency to believe in one's work-related capabilities and ability to control one's work-related outcomes.

name: Perseverance
desc: A tendency to exhibit determination and resolve to perform or complete tasks in the face of difficult circumstances or obstacles at work.

name: Leadership Orientation
desc: A tendency to lead, take charge, offer opinions, and provide direction at work.

name: Humility
desc: A tendency to be modest and humble when interacting with others at work.

name: Sincerity
desc: A tendency to be genuine and sincere in interactions with others at work, without concern for personal gain or self-interest.

name: Empathy
desc: A tendency to show concern for others and be sensitive to others' needs and feelings at work.

name: Cooperation
desc: A tendency to be pleasant, helpful, and willing to assist others at work.

name: Optimism
desc: A tendency to exhibit a positive attitude and positive emotions at work, even under difficult circumstances.

name: Social Orientation
desc: A tendency to seek out, enjoy, and be energized by social interaction at work.

name: Cautiousness
desc: A tendency to be careful, deliberate, and risk-avoidant when making work-related decisions or doing work.

name: Attention to Detail
desc: A tendency to be detail-oriented, organized, and thorough in completing work.

name: Dependability
desc: A tendency to be reliable, responsible, and consistent in meeting work-related obligations.

name: Integrity
desc: A tendency to be honest and ethical at work.

name: Stress Tolerance
desc: A tendency to cope and function effectively in stressful situations at work.

name: Self-Control
desc: A tendency to remain calm and composed and to manage emotions effectively in response to criticism or difficult situations at work.
